mapper.sql: PA.PERSON_ID, PA.EMPID, PA.LOCAL_NAME, PA.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(PA.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POST_FAMILY_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_FAMILY_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POSITION_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT TT.SALARY_DISTIN_NAME, SUM(TT.PREV_COUNT) AS PREV_COUNT, SUM(TT.CUR_COUNT) AS CUR_COUNT FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN PST.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = THEN COUNT(1) END AS CUR_COUNT, CASE WHEN PST.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = THEN COUNT(1) END AS PREV_COUNT, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PST.SALARY_DISTIN_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS SALARY_DISTIN_NAME FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PST WHERE PST.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PST.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO, PST.SALARY_DISTIN_NO) TT WHERE (TT.CUR_COUNT > 0 OR TT.PREV_COUNT > 0) GROUP BY TT.SALARY_DISTIN_NAME

SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_STARTED, 'YYYY/MM/DD') BETWEEN PST.HR_START_DATE AND PST.HR_START_DATE THEN 'RECRUIT' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS CATEGORY, NVL(COUNT(1), 0) AS NUMB, ZH_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ROWNUM <= 300 THEN HE.PERSON_ID END) AS PERSON_ID_PART1, ZH_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ROWNUM > 300 AND ROWNUM <= 600 THEN HE.PERSON_ID END) AS PERSON_ID_PART2, ZH_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ROWNUM > 600 THEN HE.PERSON_ID END) AS PERSON_ID_PART3 FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PST, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = PST.PERSON_ID AND PST.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = AND PST.PERSON_ID NOT IN (SELECT PSTS.PERSON_ID FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PSTS WHERE PSTS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = ) GROUP BY CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_STARTED, 'YYYY/MM/DD') BETWEEN PST.HR_START_DATE AND PST.HR_START_DATE THEN 'RECRUIT' ELSE 'OTHER' END

SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_LEFT, 'YYYY/MM/DD') BETWEEN PST.HR_START_DATE AND PST.HR_END_DATE THEN 'RESIGN' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS CATEGORY, NVL(COUNT(1), 0) AS NUMB, ZH_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ROWNUM <= 300 THEN HE.PERSON_ID END) AS PERSON_ID_PART1, ZH_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ROWNUM > 300 AND ROWNUM <= 600 THEN HE.PERSON_ID END) AS PERSON_ID_PART2, ZH_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ROWNUM > 600 THEN HE.PERSON_ID END) AS PERSON_ID_PART3 FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PST, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = PST.PERSON_ID AND PST.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = AND PST.PERSON_ID NOT IN (SELECT PSTS.PERSON_ID FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PSTS WHERE PSTS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = ) GROUP BY CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_LEFT, 'YYYY/MM/DD') BETWEEN PST.HR_START_DATE AND PST.HR_END_DATE THEN 'RESIGN' ELSE 'OTHER' END

SELECT HE.PERSON_ID, HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HE.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(HE.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.POST_FAMILY, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_FAMILY_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POSITION_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.DUTY_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DUTY_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.EMP_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS EMP_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_LEFT, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_LEFT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(HEI.START_DATE, 'DD.MM.YYYY'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS TRANS_DATE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HEI.TRANS_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRANS_CODE_NAME FROM HR_EXPERIENCE_INSIDE HEI, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE HEI.ACTIVITY = 1 AND HE.PERSON_ID = HEI.PERSON_ID AND HE.PERSON_ID NOT LIKE '11111%' AND HE.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(HEI.START_DATE, 'DD.MM.YYYY'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') BETWEEN TO_CHAR((SELECT PSS.AR_START_DATE FROM PA_PAY_SCHEDULE PSS WHERE PSS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = #{payScheduleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AND TO_CHAR((SELECT PSS.AR_END_DATE FROM PA_PAY_SCHEDULE PSS WHERE PSS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = #{payScheduleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY.MM.DD')
AND (HE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #{empSearch, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(HE.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{empSearch, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' OR HE.ENGLISH_NAME LIKE '%' || #{empSearch, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
ORDER BY HE.EMPID, HEI.START_DATE

SELECT , GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.EMP_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS EMP_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(PA.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(PA.DATE_LEFT, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_LEFT, TO_CHAR(PA.END_PROBATION_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS END_PROBATION_DATE, PA.REAL_WAGES FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PA WHERE PA.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PA.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = #{payScheduleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT NULL AS ITEM_ID, P.ITEM_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(P.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS ITEM_NAME, TO_CHAR(P.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE, P.ITEM_VALUE, P.ITEM_FORMULAR FROM PA_SALARY_DETAIL_PAGE_DATA P WHERE P.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND P.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY P.ITEM_TYPE, P.ORDERNO

SELECT PII.ITEM_ID, PII.ITEM_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PII.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS ITEM_NAME, TO_CHAR(PII.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE, NULL AS ITEM_VALUE, NULL AS ITEM_FORMULAR FROM PA_ITEM_INPUT PII WHERE PII.IS_USE = 4 AND PII.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PII.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY PII.ITEM_TYPE, PII.ORDERNO

SELECT PA.PERSON_ID, PA.EMPID, PA.LOCAL_NAME, PA.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(PA.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POST_FAMILY_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_FAMILY_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POSITION_NAME, PA.${itemColumn} AS PAY_NUMBER, (SELECT PCF.FORMULAR_VALUE FROM PA_CAL_FORMULAR_HTSV PCF WHERE PCF.ITEM_ID = #{itemId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PCF.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO AND PCF.PERSON_ID = PA.PERSON_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS FORMULAR_VALUE, (SELECT PPD.REMARK FROM PA_PARAM_DATA PPD WHERE PPD.PARAM_NO = (SELECT PPIP.PARAM_NO FROM PA_PARAM_ITEM_PARAM PPIP WHERE PPIP.PARAM_ITEM_NO = (SELECT PPI.PARAM_ITEM_NO FROM PA_PARAM_ITEM PPI WHERE PPI.PARAM_ITEM_ID = #{itemId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PPI.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1) AND ROWNUM = 1) AND ROWNUM = 1) AS REMARK FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PA WHERE PA.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = #{payScheduleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY PA.EMPID
mapper.update: { CALL PA_MONTH_DIF_ITEM_VIEW2( #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{payDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD-MM-YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{payDatePro, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD-MM-YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{salaryDistinNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '4', '3' ) }
mapper.select: SELECT PDIT.ITEM_ID, PDIT.ITEM_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PDIT.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS ITEM_NAME, TO_CHAR(PDIT.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE, TO_CHAR(PDIT.MONTH_DIF) AS MONTH_DIF, COUNT(PDIT.PERSON_ID) AS PERSON_NUM, SUM(PDIT.MONTH_PRO) AS MONTH_PRO, SUM(PDIT.MONTH_NOW) AS MONTH_NOW FROM PA_MONTH_DIF_ITEM_TEMP PDIT WHERE PDIT.CREATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PDIT.ITEM_TYPE = #{itemType, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND PDIT.PAGE_TYPE = #{pageType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PDIT.ITEM_ID, PDIT.MONTH_DIF, PDIT.ITEM_NO, PDIT.ITEM_TYPE ORDER BY PDIT.MONTH_DIF, PDIT.ITEM_NO

SELECT T.ITEM_ID, NULL AS ITEM_NO, T.ITEM_NAME, TO_CHAR(T.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE, TO_CHAR(T.PAGE_TYPE) AS PAGE_TYPE, NULL AS MONTH_DIF, SUM(T.PERSON_NUM) AS PERSON_NUM, NULL AS MONTH_PRO, NULL AS MONTH_NOW, SUM(T.PERSON_NUM_PRO) AS PERSON_NUM_PRO, SUM(T.PERSON_NUM) - SUM(T.PERSON_NUM_PRO) AS PERSON_NUM_DIF, SUM(T.COUNT_NUM) AS COUNT_NUM, SUM(T.COUNT_NUM_PRO) AS COUNT_NUM_PRO, SUM(T.COUNT_NUM) - SUM(T.COUNT_NUM_PRO) AS COUNT_NUM_DIF, ROUND(SUM(T.COUNT_NUM) / CASE WHEN SUM(T.PERSON_NUM) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(T.PERSON_NUM) END, 2) AS PERSON_NUM_AVG, ROUND(SUM(T.COUNT_NUM_PRO) / CASE WHEN SUM(T.PERSON_NUM_PRO) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(T.PERSON_NUM_PRO) END, 2) AS PERSON_NUM_AVG_PRO, ROUND(SUM(T.COUNT_NUM) / CASE WHEN SUM(T.PERSON_NUM) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(T.PERSON_NUM) END - SUM(T.COUNT_NUM_PRO) / CASE WHEN SUM(T.PERSON_NUM_PRO) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(T.PERSON_NUM_PRO) END, 2) AS PERSON_NUM_AVG_DIF, SUM(T.COUNT_UP) AS COUNT_UP, SUM(T.COUNT_LOW) AS COUNT_LOW, SUM(T.PERSON_UP) AS PERSON_UP, SUM(T.PERSON_LOW) AS PERSON_LOW FROM (SELECT COUNT(PDIT.ITEM_ID) AS PERSON_NUM, 0 AS PERSON_NUM_PRO, SUM(PDIT.MONTH_NOW) AS COUNT_NUM, 0 AS COUNT_NUM_PRO, 0 AS COUNT_UP, 0 AS COUNT_LOW, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PDIT.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS ITEM_NAME, PDIT.PAGE_TYPE, PDIT.ITEM_ID, PDIT.ITEM_TYPE, SUM(CASE WHEN PDIT.PERSON_ID NOT IN (SELECT PDIT2.PERSON_ID FROM PA_MONTH_DIF_ITEM_TEMP PDIT2 WHERE PDIT2.ITEM_ID = PDIT.ITEM_ID AND PDIT2.PAGE_TYPE = '3' AND PDIT2.CREATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PDIT2.MONTH_PRO <> '0') THEN 1 END) AS PERSON_UP, 0 AS PERSON_LOW, MAX(PDIT.ORDERNO) AS ORDERNO FROM PA_MONTH_DIF_ITEM_TEMP PDIT WHERE PDIT.PAGE_TYPE = '3' AND PDIT.MONTH_NOW <> '0' AND PDIT.CREATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PDIT.ITEM_ID, PDIT.ITEM_NO, PDIT.PAGE_TYPE, PDIT.ITEM_TYPE UNION ALL SELECT 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN PDIT.MONTH_NOW > PDIT.MONTH_PRO THEN 1 END), SUM(CASE WHEN PDIT.MONTH_NOW < PDIT.MONTH_PRO THEN 1 END), GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PDIT.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), PDIT.PAGE_TYPE, PDIT.ITEM_ID, PDIT.ITEM_TYPE, 0, 0, MAX(PDIT.ORDERNO) FROM PA_MONTH_DIF_ITEM_TEMP PDIT WHERE PDIT.PAGE_TYPE = '3' AND PDIT.CREATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PDIT.ITEM_ID, PDIT.ITEM_NO, PDIT.PAGE_TYPE, PDIT.ITEM_TYPE UNION ALL SELECT 0, COUNT(PDIT.ITEM_ID), 0, SUM(PDIT.MONTH_PRO), 0, 0, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PDIT.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), PDIT.PAGE_TYPE, PDIT.ITEM_ID, PDIT.ITEM_TYPE, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN PDIT.PERSON_ID NOT IN (SELECT PDIT2.PERSON_ID FROM PA_MONTH_DIF_ITEM_TEMP PDIT2 WHERE PDIT2.ITEM_ID = PDIT.ITEM_ID AND PDIT2.PAGE_TYPE = '3' AND PDIT2.CREATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PDIT2.MONTH_NOW <> '0') THEN 1 END), MAX(PDIT.ORDERNO) FROM PA_MONTH_DIF_ITEM_TEMP PDIT WHERE PDIT.PAGE_TYPE = '3' AND PDIT.CREATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PDIT.MONTH_PRO <> '0' GROUP BY PDIT.ITEM_ID, PDIT.ITEM_NO, PDIT.PAGE_TYPE, PDIT.ITEM_TYPE) T GROUP BY T.ITEM_ID, T.ITEM_NAME, T.PAGE_TYPE, T.ITEM_TYPE, T.ORDERNO ORDER BY T.ITEM_TYPE, T.ORDERNO
mapper.sql: SELECT COUNT(PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO) AS PERSON_NUM, SUM(PA.REAL_WAGES) AS NET_PAY, SUM(PA.ATT_DEDUCT_TOTAL) + SUM(PA.PERSONAL_INS_TOTAL) + SUM(PA.PERSONAL_TAX) + SUM(PA.P_PRE_TAX_MINUS) + SUM(PA.P_AFTER_TAX_MINUS) AS WITHHOLD_TOTAL FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PA
mapper.select: SELECT #{payDatePro, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS PAY_DATE_PRO, #{payDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS PAY_DATE_CUR, PA_PRO.PERSON_NUM AS PERSON_NUM_PRO, PA_PRO.NET_PAY + PA_PRO.WITHHOLD_TOTAL AS SALARY_TOTAL_PRO, PA_PRO.WITHHOLD_TOTAL AS WITHHOLD_TOTAL_PRO, PA_PRO.NET_PAY AS NET_PAY_PRO, PA_CUR.PERSON_NUM AS PERSON_NUM_CUR, PA_CUR.NET_PAY + PA_CUR.WITHHOLD_TOTAL AS SALARY_TOTAL_CUR, PA_CUR.WITHHOLD_TOTAL AS WITHHOLD_TOTAL_CUR, PA_CUR.NET_PAY AS NET_PAY_CUR, PA_CUR.PERSON_NUM - PA_PRO.PERSON_NUM AS PERSON_NUM_DIF, (PA_CUR.NET_PAY + PA_CUR.WITHHOLD_TOTAL) - (PA_PRO.NET_PAY + PA_PRO.WITHHOLD_TOTAL) AS SALARY_TOTAL_DIF, PA_CUR.WITHHOLD_TOTAL - PA_PRO.WITHHOLD_TOTAL AS WITHHOLD_TOTAL_DIF, PA_CUR.NET_PAY - PA_PRO.NET_PAY AS NET_PAY_DIF FROM ( WHERE PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = ) PA_PRO, ( WHERE PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = ) PA_CUR

SELECT , P.ITEM_NAME, P.CAL_VALUE, P.FORMULAR_VALUE, TO_CHAR(PA.AR_START_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS AR_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(PA.AR_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS AR_END_DATE FROM PA_CAL_FORMULAR_HTSV P, PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PA WHERE P.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = AND P.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO AND P.PERSON_ID = PA.PERSON_ID AND P.ITEM_NO IN (570019, 570026, 570033) AND P.CAL_VALUE > 0
ORDER BY PA.EMPID, P.ITEM_NO

SELECT , PA.SOCIAL_INS_PERSONAL, PA.MEDICAL_INS_PERSONAL, PA.UNEMPLOYMENT_INS_PERSONAL, PA.PERSONAL_INS_TOTAL FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PA WHERE PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO =
ORDER BY PA.EMPID

SELECT , PA.INCOME_BEFORE_TAX, PA.ATT_DEDUCT_TOTAL, PA.PERSONAL_INS_TOTAL, PA.P_TAX_DEDUCT_STD, PA.P_TAX_FAMILY_DEDUCT_STD, PA.P_TAX_FAMILY_DEDUCT_COUNT, PA.TAXABLE_INCOME, PA.PT_TAX_RATE, PA.QUICK_DEDUCTION_TAX, PA.PERSONAL_TAX, PA.REAL_WAGES FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PA WHERE PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO =
ORDER BY PA.EMPID
